registry.name: Sui
registry.note: Settlement layer: balances, stakes and transaction status read live. Plain coin transfers build + simulate in Noise; wallet signs. (No `objects` action: no HTTP surface exposes raw object listing.)

registry.name: Sui Native Staking
registry.note: Native validator staking: stake, unstake, rewards and validators.

registry.name: Cetus
registry.ref: partner closed to new teams → policy 0
registry.note: Primary swap router: quote → build → simulate → wallet signing flow; signed E2E is not certified by this audit. No Cetus LP-position adapter exists, so no `position` capability is claimed.

registry.name: Aftermath
registry.note: Live data, unsigned swap and LP deposit/withdraw builders. Swap and LP deposit dry-run verified. Wallet signing and funded LP withdrawals require user E2E validation.

registry.name: DeepBook
registry.note: Sui's native onchain liquidity layer. Live markets, L2 orderbook, order build/cancel via BalanceManager.

registry.name: DeepBook Predict
registry.note: Live prediction markets: UP/DOWN mint, redeem, claim-settled, positions.

registry.name: DeepBook Margin
registry.note: On-chain preflight (enabled pools SUI_USDC, DEEP_USDC + margin pool ids) and margin-account creation wired + simulated. Leveraged borrow/trade needs a user MarginManager + fresh Pyth feeds — built per-manager after setup E2E.

registry.name: Turbos
registry.note: Live pool reads and swaps via Cetus Aggregator restricted to TURBOS; each returned path is checked and must simulate before wallet signing. LP deposits are not included.

registry.name: FlowX
registry.note: In-hub swap quotes and PTBs via Cetus Aggregator restricted to FLOWX/FLOWXV3; every returned path is checked. No direct LP integration.

registry.name: Momentum
registry.note: In-hub swap quotes and PTBs via Cetus Aggregator restricted to MOMENTUM. Mainnet dry-run verified; direct LP integration is not included.

registry.name: Kriya
registry.note: SUNSET — protocol is winding down. kriya.finance and docs.kriya.finance failed the TLS handshake at the 2026-10-07 audit; deep-link disabled rather than shipping a broken link.

registry.name: Metastable
registry.note: Aftermath-incubated Sui stablecoin vaults (mUSD 17 assets, mSUI 16, mBTC, mETH — all read live). Previous metastable.io domain is dead — canonical home is mstable.io. mSUI mint/burn builds via the official SDK; mUSD/mBTC/mETH need a Pyth key the bundled SDK cannot pass (Hermes 401) — honest blocker. E2E proof needs a funded wallet run.

registry.name: Bluefin Spot
registry.note: Bluefin AMM spot swaps inside Noise via Cetus Aggregator restricted to BLUEFIN. This is not Bluefin perps or account-based orderbook execution.

registry.name: Bluefin Perps
registry.dataSource: Bluefin Pro API (public market data, no key)
registry.note: Live perps markets, orderbook depth and 24h tickers in Discover. Trading needs a venue account — execution on Bluefin. (docs.bluefin.io returned 404 at the 2026-10-07 audit.)

registry.name: Typus
registry.note: Options vaults need user vault positions + auctions on the venue — no public execution API found 2026-10-06. Deep-link only.

registry.name: Sudo
registry.note: On-chain perps on Sui (sub-second, Pyth oracles). No public market-data API found 2026-10-06 — execution on the venue, deep-link only.

registry.name: Perpsplexity
registry.note: Live venue status read; execution on the venue. No public token-discovery API.

registry.name: NAVI
registry.note: Live markets (35 pools), positions, health factor and rewards. Supply/withdraw/borrow/repay/claim PTBs build + simulate via the new @naviprotocol/lending SDK; wallet signs. E2E proof needs a funded wallet run.

registry.name: Suilend
registry.note: Live markets (45 reserves) with real deposit/borrow APR + utilization from the on-chain interest-rate curve (SDK parseReserve), and obligation positions. Supply/withdraw/borrow/repay/claim PTBs build + simulate; wallet signs. E2E proof needs a funded wallet run.

registry.name: Scallop
registry.note: Live markets, obligations and portfolio. Supply/withdraw/borrow/repay PTBs build unsigned via the official SDK; wallet signs. E2E proof needs a funded wallet run.

registry.name: Bucket
registry.note: Live PSM pools, collaterals and USDB supply. USDB PSM swaps build + simulate; wallet signs. sUSDB savings deposit needs an lpType the SDK cannot enumerate (upstream BigInt bug) — honest blocker.

registry.name: AlphaLend
registry.note: SUNSET — AlphaFi (operator) is winding down. Withdraw via the provider; no new positions through Noise. (The AlphaLend doc path is gone — it redirects to a generic old-doc page; docs link removed 2026-10-07.)

registry.name: Haedal
registry.dataSource: Haedal on-chain interface (devInspect reads + Move builds)
registry.fee: instant: protocol fee and liquidity; delayed ticket/claim
registry.note: Live haSUI/SUI rate, positions and tickets. Stake (min 1 SUI, auto or chosen validator), delayed/instant unstake and ticket claim PTBs build via the upgraded staking package; wallet signs. E2E proof needs a funded wallet run.

registry.name: Volo
registry.note: Unsigned Volo stake/redeem PTBs; shared object types and protocol fees read on-chain. Stake and atomic stake/redeem dry-run verified; wallet signing remains user-controlled.

registry.name: SpringSui
registry.note: Live sSUI/SUI rate and dynamic on-chain totals. Mint/redeem PTBs build + simulate; wallet signs. Instant unstaking via SIP-33. E2E proof needs a funded wallet run.

registry.name: AlphaFi
registry.note: SUNSET — AlphaFi is winding down (official site notice). Withdraw via the provider; no new positions through Noise.

registry.name: Kai
registry.note: No public markets/execution API found 2026-10-06 — execution on the venue, deep-link only.

registry.name: Nemo
registry.note: BTCFi yield. nemo.fi did not answer (TCP 443 timeout) at the 2026-10-07 audit — no verified live domain, so the deep-link is disabled rather than shipping a dead link.

registry.name: STEAMM
registry.note: Real STEAMM LP deposit/withdraw PTBs via official SDK, authoritative pool types, quoted minima and simulation gate. CP pool deposit/redeem dry-run verified. STEAMM swap routing is not enabled; oracle swaps require a separate Pyth Pro integration.

registry.name: SuiPump
registry.note: Live launchpad tokens: factual metrics only, never recommendations.

registry.name: Sui Bridge
registry.note: Native bridge. Deep link — execution leaves Noise Hub.

registry.name: Wormhole / Portal
registry.note: Bridge. Deep link only.
